releaseNotes: Photos multi-select now includes Share, Move, Delete, and More. Move, Copy to Album, Create Album, and Delete are real Android media operations so changes are reflected in the device gallery. More includes Copy to Album, Add to Favorites, and Create Album. A new Photo file names setting can show each filename under its thumbnail with fixed one-line spacing and ellipsis for long names. Category Rename and the existing saved-index-first Search behavior are preserved.
